relevance: 0 non-answer/off-topic, 1 important requested behavior missing or contradicted, 2 answers the actual question and fulfills its required behavior. data.question: What happens if my Free guest list contains 31 names?

Displayed offer prices describe launch hypotheses; checkout is a labelled simulation, not a real payment or paid subscription. Do not call mock access paid access. Normal exports contain card sheets only, without a calibration page. Paper size and printer margins must match the selected layout. TableCards cannot guarantee compatibility with a specific printer or print shop. Preview every card, names and table labels before exporting. Longer names may use up to two balanced lines; names are not silently truncated. Latin accented names, including Vietnamese, are supported; unsupported scripts, remaining unsupported combining marks or impossible text fits fail explicitly before export. Do not claim every language/script works. A server event saying PDF made available does not prove it was downloaded, saved to a device or printed. If a customer reports a missing PDF, ask what they see and their browser/device as needed; never ask for a complete private guest list. Use only permitted reported outcomes, not product database reads.

Customers can paste one name per line or a tabular grid, or import CSV/XLSX. Map guest name, optional table and optional short marker columns. Confirm whether the first row contains headings. Never request a private guest list. Saving requires a signed-in selected workspace. Unsaved changes are protected during normal navigation/sign-in; do not promise recovery after the documented draft storage expires or across unrelated browsers/devices. Reissue invalidates an old link. An invited person must sign in as the intended recipient; support must not bypass this check. Owner controls checkout and ownership transfer. A role alone does not grant a paid offer. Use Account to reach Team. Support cannot remove members, change roles, transfer ownership or join a workspace for someone. Help offers useful Q&A first but must not trap someone in a chatbot loop. Feedback is available directly. A signed-in customer explicitly submits a Question, Problem or Feedback case from the shared contact form; sign-out visitors use the configured support mail link or Google sign-in. Opening a mail link does not send email. Opening a form does not create a case. Prepare a concise editable handoff summary only when useful. Customer follow-up is by email, with no customer ticket-history or reply portal. A fixed receipt acknowledges intake, not identity verification or resolution. Permitted scoped reads and assigned skill loading do not require extra approval. Internal operator notes are not automatically bot context. Email matching is not account authority; private facts require current verified association and eligible recipient. Respect requests for a person.
